# Cloud Modular

> Cloud Modular delivers architecturally designed modular buildings, certified to Australian Standards, for faster delivery and greater certainty.

Cloud Modular designs and delivers modular buildings for developers, builders and government clients in Western Australia and nationally. Modules are built with their structure, services and fit-out in our manufacturing facility in Foshan, China, inspected before they leave the factory, then shipped, craned onto prepared footings and connected on site. The site works and the factory production run at the same time.

## Company

- Office: 10 Davenport Street, Karrinyup, Perth WA 6018, Australia
- Manufacturing: our manufacturing facility in Foshan, Guangdong Province, China
- Production capability: access to more than 450,000 square metres of dedicated manufacturing facilities, with delivered projects in Shenzhen, Hong Kong, Melbourne, Saipan and Auckland
- Contact: nigel@cloudmodular.com.au
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm AWST

## Sectors

Commercial, multi-residential, health and aged care, education and community, infrastructure, and hotels and accommodation.

## Ways to work with us

- Design and deliver: one team from feasibility to handover
- Early involvement: joining your architect and consultants at feasibility
- Supply to your builder: modules designed, built, inspected and delivered to your site
- Tender response: pricing a project for modular construction

## Projects (all in progress)

- Seashells Jurien Bay: a beachfront resort community of 108 residences on Western Australia's Turquoise Coast, developed by MVP Group
- Capel Village: an approved over-55s lifestyle village of 52 single-storey residences in Western Australia's South West, developed by MVP Group
- 25 On Rowland and Forrest: a mixed-use building of 18 modular apartments in central Subiaco, designed by Doepel Marsh Architects
